title: Indoors
intro: The back door was open for exactly four minutes. That was enough.
Inside lies a world of tiles and carpet, a kitchen of endless crumbs, and a sugar bowl like a mountain of snow.
Also a cat. And a homeowner. And, if we are careless, a man with a van.
outro: The van pulls away. The homeowner shrugs and leaves the biscuit tin open again.
Under the kitchen floor, a vast colony hums with life, fed on sugar and stubbornness.
Antonia, very old now, sits at the edge of the sugar bowl. 'Not bad,' she says. 'Not bad at all.'

objectives.text: Find a way into the House
Harvest 400 sugar from the kitchen crumbs

params.speaker: Queen
params.text: The giants' nest. Warm, dry and full of sugar. We go in quietly.

params.speaker: Antonia
params.text: Quietly. Right. Two hundred of us. In a straight line. Across a white kitchen floor.

params.speaker: Antonia
params.text: The cat's watching the skirting board. Don't make eye contact. We don't have eyes worth mentioning, but still.

params.speaker: Queen
params.text: They know we are here. Let them come. This is our home now.

params.speaker: Antonia
params.text: He's gone. Packed his little sprayer and left. Somebody remind me to bite something in celebration.
